items.title: Saturday, November 14th, 2026
items.summary: # I hate ends and endings. It's the change. I get used to things, comfortable even. When things end I want to keep hold of that familiar feeling. I don't want to move on. Even when reaching "The End" I want to know what happens next. Yes, but... Characters don't stop existing just because the story is done.

items.title: Thursday, October 29th, 2026
items.summary: # Things have been a bit quiet round here for one reason or another, but I couldn't let today pass without the annual reminder to " choose the web you want " rather than just falling into big tech defaults. Whatever you do on the internet, do it on your own terms. Own your data and identity.
